name: Bachelor in Business Administration (BBA)
requirements_summary: Minimum entry level for BBA and BHCM is Higher Secondary School Level (10+2) or equivalent A-Levels, CBSE or other courses recognised by the National Education Board of Nepal, with a minimum of second division (45% aggregate) or 2.0 CGPA and minimum Grade C in each subject. Students must also pass the college entrance test, group discussion, and interview.
source_note: Visually extracted from the 2018/19 prospectus because the PDF uses outlined fonts that do not expose reliable text. Institution is in Kathmandu, Nepal and must be reviewed for EduGuide LS scope before publishing to students.
